newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Sao Paulo industrial activity up 12.5 pct in Nov.
newsitem.headline: Sao Paulo industrial activity up 12.5 pct in Nov.

text.p: Sao Paulo state's industrial activity rose 12.5 percent in November 1996, compared with the same period the year before, the Sao Paulo state Industries Federation (Fiesp) said in a statement.
November industrial activity also rose 1.0 percent when compared to the previous month.
Industrial sales rose 14.2 percent in November against the same month in 1995, and rose 3.6 percent when compared to October 1996 figures, it added.
